translations.it.karamati: Tu sei Colui che umilia (Al-Mudhill), alla cui potenza si sono umiliati gli uomini, i jinn e Satana, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Humiliator (Al-Mudhill), before Whose might mankind, the jinn and Satan have been humbled, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es Celui qui humilie (Al-Mudhill), devant la puissance duquel se sont humiliés les hommes, les djinns et Satan, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ السَّمِيعُ الَّذِى نَاجَيْتُهُ زَمَنًا ۞ وَبِالْمَسَرَاتِ لِى قَدْ جُدْتَّ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei l'Audiente (As-Samīʿ), con cui ho conversato intimamente a lungo, e di gioie mi sei stato prodigo, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the All-Hearing (As-Samīʿ), with Whom I have conversed intimately for a long time, and with joys You have been lavish to me, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es l'Audient (As-Samīʿ), avec qui j'ai conversé intimement longtemps, et de joies Tu m'as été prodigue, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْبَصِيرُ الَّذِى لِى قَادَ جُمْلَةَ مَا ۞ لِى اخْتَرْتَ دُنْيَا وَأُخْرَى مِنْكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Veggente (Al-Baṣīr), che mi ha condotto l'insieme di ciò che hai scelto per me, in questo mondo e nell'altro, da parte Tua, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the All-Seeing (Al-Baṣīr), Who has led to me all that You chose for me, in this world and the next, from You, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Clairvoyant (Al-Baṣīr), qui m'a conduit l'ensemble de ce que Tu as choisi pour moi, en ce monde et dans l'autre, de Ta part, ô Allah.

bayts.text: حَكَمْتَ يَاحَكَمُ الْبَاقِى بِكَوْنِىَ ذَا ۞ فَوْزٍ بَمَا غَابِ مِنْ بُشْرَاكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Hai decretato, o Giudice (Al-Ḥakam) Eterno, che io sia possessore di successo, per ciò che è nascosto delle Tue buone novelle, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have decreed, O Everlasting Judge (Al-Ḥakam), that I be a possessor of success, through what is hidden of Your glad tidings, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu as décrété, ô Juge (Al-Ḥakam) Éternel, que je sois détenteur du succès, par ce qui est caché de Tes bonnes nouvelles, ô Allah.

bayts.text: عَتَلْتَ يَاعَدْلُ أَعْدَاءِى بِغَيْرِ لِقَآ ۞ وَلَا ضِرَارٍ وَلِى قَدْ كُنْتَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Hai trascinato via, o Giusto (Al-ʿAdl), i miei nemici, senza scontro né danno, e per me sei stato, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have dragged away, O Just (Al-ʿAdl), my enemies, without encounter or harm, and You have been for me, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu as traîné au loin, ô Juste (Al-ʿAdl), mes ennemis, sans affrontement ni dommage, et pour moi Tu as été, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ اللَّطِيفُ الَّذِى قَدْ قُدْتَّ لِى أَبَدًا ۞ لُّطْفًا عَجِيبًا يَزِيدُ الْفِكْرَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Sottile (Al-Laṭīf), che mi hai condotto per sempre una sottile benevolenza mirabile che accresce la riflessione, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Subtle (Al-Laṭīf), Who have led to me forever a wondrous subtle kindness that increases reflection, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Subtil (Al-Laṭīf), qui m'as conduit pour toujours une subtile bienveillance merveilleuse qui accroît la réflexion, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْخَبِيرُ الَّذِى عَايَنْتُ خُبْرَتَهُ ۞ وَقُدْتَّ لِى مِنْكَ عِلْمَ الْغَيْبِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Ben Informato (Al-Khabīr), la cui conoscenza ho visto con i miei occhi, e mi hai condotto da Te la scienza dell'invisibile, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the All-Aware (Al-Khabīr), Whose knowledge I have seen with my eyes, and You have led to me from You the knowledge of the unseen, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Parfaitement Informé (Al-Khabīr), dont j'ai vu de mes yeux la connaissance, et Tu m'as conduit de Ta part la science de l'invisible, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْحَلِيمُ الَّذِى زَحْزَحْتَ جُمْلَتَ مَنْ ۞ لَّمْ تَرْضَهُمْ لِى لِغَيْرِى الدَّهْرَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Clemente (Al-Ḥalīm), che hai allontanato tutti coloro che non hai gradito per me, verso altri, per sempre, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Forbearing (Al-Ḥalīm), Who have removed all those You did not approve for me, toward others, forever, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Longanime (Al-Ḥalīm), qui as écarté tous ceux que Tu n'as pas agréés pour moi, vers d'autres, pour toujours, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْعَظِيمُ الَّذِى بَانَتْ عَظَامَتُهُ ۞ لِى قُدْتَّ فَضْلًا عَظِيمًا مِّنْكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei l'Immenso (Al-ʿAẓīm), la cui grandezza è apparsa; mi hai condotto un favore immenso da parte Tua, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Magnificent (Al-ʿAẓīm), Whose greatness has appeared; You have led to me an immense favour from You, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es l'Immense (Al-ʿAẓīm), dont la grandeur est apparue ; Tu m'as conduit une faveur immense de Ta part, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الَّذِى لِى قُدْتَّ مَغْفِرَةً ۞ مَّحَتْ عُيُوبِى رَضِيتُ عَنْكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Perdonatore (Al-Ghafūr), che mi hai condotto un perdono che ha cancellato i miei difetti: mi sono compiaciuto di Te, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the All-Forgiving (Al-Ghafūr), Who have led to me a forgiveness that effaced my faults: I am well pleased with You, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Très-Pardonnant (Al-Ghafūr), qui m'as conduit un pardon qui a effacé mes défauts : je me suis satisfait de Toi, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الشَّكُورُ الَّذِى كُلِّى لَدَيْكَ رِضًى ۞ وَلِى شَكَرْتَ جَمِيعِ السَّعْىِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Riconoscente (Ash-Shakūr), presso cui tutto il mio essere è compiacimento, e per me hai gradito tutto lo sforzo, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Appreciative (Ash-Shakūr), with Whom my whole being is good pleasure, and for me You have appreciated all the striving, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Reconnaissant (Ash-Shakūr), auprès de qui tout mon être est agrément, et pour moi Tu as agréé tout l'effort, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْعَلِىُّ الَّذِى أَعْلَيْتَنِى أَبَدًا ۞ بِغَيْرِ مَكْرٍ وَلِى حَلَّلْتَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei l'Altissimo (Al-ʿAlī), che mi hai innalzato per sempre senza inganno, e per me hai reso lecito (il bene), o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Most High (Al-ʿAlī), Who have raised me forever without guile, and for me You have made (good) lawful, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Très-Haut (Al-ʿAlī), qui m'as élevé pour toujours sans ruse, et pour moi Tu as rendu licite (le bien), ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْكَبِيرُ الَّذِى بَانَتْ كَبَارَتُهُ ۞ لِى قُدْتَّ مِنْكَ كَبِيرَ الْأَجْرِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Grande (Al-Kabīr), la cui grandezza è apparsa; mi hai condotto da Te una grande ricompensa, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Great (Al-Kabīr), Whose greatness has appeared; You have led to me from You a great reward, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Grand (Al-Kabīr), dont la grandeur est apparue ; Tu m'as conduit de Ta part une grande récompense, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْحَفِيظُ الَّذِى وَجَّهْتَ فِى أَبَدٍ ۞ إِلَى سِوَاىَ الْعِدَى وَالضُّرَّ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Custode (Al-Ḥafīẓ), che hai rivolto per sempre verso altri che me i nemici e il danno, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Preserver (Al-Ḥafīẓ), Who have turned forever toward others than me the enemies and harm, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Gardien (Al-Ḥafīẓ), qui as tourné pour toujours vers d'autres que moi les ennemis et le mal, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْمُقِيتُ الَّذِى خَلَّدْتَّ لِى رَغَدًا ۞ بِلَا حِسَابٍ إِلَى الْجَنَّاتِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Nutritore (Al-Muqīt), che hai reso perenne per me l'agiatezza, senza conto, fino ai Giardini, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Sustainer (Al-Muqīt), Who have made ease everlasting for me, without reckoning, until the Gardens, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Nourricier (Al-Muqīt), qui as rendu perpétuelle pour moi l'aisance, sans compter, jusqu'aux Jardins, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْحَسِيبُ الَّذِى قَدِ اكْتَفَيْتُ بِهِ ۞ عَنِ الْعِدَى وَالْأَذَى وَالْكَدِّ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei Colui che basta (Al-Ḥasīb), del quale mi sono accontentato, (al riparo) dai nemici, dal danno e dalla fatica, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Sufficient Reckoner (Al-Ḥasīb), with Whom I have been content, (sheltered) from enemies, harm and toil, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es Celui qui suffit (Al-Ḥasīb), dont je me suis contenté, (à l'abri) des ennemis, du mal et de la peine, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْجَلِيلُ الَّذِى سَاقَتْ جَلَالَتُهُ ۞ إِلَى سِوَانَا الْعِدَى الدَّارَيْنِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Maestoso (Al-Jalīl), la cui maestà ha sospinto verso altri che noi i nemici, nelle due Dimore, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Majestic (Al-Jalīl), Whose majesty has driven the enemies toward others than us, in the two Abodes, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Majestueux (Al-Jalīl), dont la majesté a poussé vers d'autres que nous les ennemis, dans les deux Demeures, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْكَرِيمُ الَّذِى قَدْ قُدْتَّ لِى كَرَمًا ۞ دُنْيَا وَأُخْرَى مَعَ التَّبْشِيرِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Generoso (Al-Karīm), che mi hai condotto generosità in questo mondo e nell'altro, con la buona novella, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Generous (Al-Karīm), Who have led generosity to me in this world and the next, with glad tidings, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Généreux (Al-Karīm), qui m'as conduit la générosité en ce monde et dans l'autre, avec la bonne nouvelle, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الرَّقِيبُ الَّذِى بَانَتْ صِيَانَتُهُ ۞ كُلِّيَّتِى عَنْ سِوَى الرِّضْوَانِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei l'Osservatore (Ar-Raqīb), la cui custodia di tutto il mio essere, da ciò che non è compiacimento, è apparsa, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Watchful (Ar-Raqīb), Whose guarding of my whole being, from all that is not good pleasure, has appeared, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es l'Observateur (Ar-Raqīb), dont la garde de tout mon être, contre ce qui n'est pas agrément, est apparue, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْمُجِيبُ الَّذِى انْقَادَتْ بِغَيْرِ عَنَآ ۞ إِجَابَةٌ مِنْكَ لِى لِى اخْتَرْتَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei Colui che esaudisce (Al-Mujīb), da cui senza fatica si è sottomessa (a me) una risposta da parte Tua, per me, in ciò che per me hai scelto, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Responsive (Al-Mujīb), through Whom without toil an answer from You has yielded (to me), for me, in what You chose for me, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es Celui qui exauce (Al-Mujīb), par qui sans peine s'est soumise (à moi) une réponse de Ta part, pour moi, en ce que Tu as choisi pour moi, ô Allah.

bayts.text: وَإِنَّكَ الْوَاسِعُ الْبَاقِى وَلِى أَبَدًا ۞ وَسَّعْتَ تَوْسِعَةً بِالْعِتْقِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: E in verità Tu sei il Vasto (Al-Wāsiʿ), l'Eterno, e per me, per sempre, hai allargato un'ampiezza con l'affrancamento (dal Fuoco), o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: And truly You are the All-Embracing (Al-Wāsiʿ), the Everlasting, and for me, forever, You have widened a breadth with emancipation (from the Fire), O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Et en vérité Tu es le Vaste (Al-Wāsiʿ), l'Éternel, et pour moi, pour toujours, Tu as élargi une ampleur par l'affranchissement (du Feu), ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْحَكِيمُ الَّذِى أَلَقْتَنِى لِسِوَى ۞ مَاسَائَنِى وَمَحَوْتَ السُّوءَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Saggio (Al-Ḥakīm), che mi hai reso adatto ad altro che ciò che mi affliggeva, e hai cancellato il male, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Wise (Al-Ḥakīm), Who have made me fit for other than what grieved me, and You have effaced the evil, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Sage (Al-Ḥakīm), qui m'as rendu apte à autre chose que ce qui m'affligeait, et Tu as effacé le mal, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْوَدُودُ الَّذِى انْقَادَتْ مَوَدَّتُهُ ۞ لِى سَرْمَدًا بِالرِّضَى وَالْقُرْبِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei l'Amorevole (Al-Wadūd), il cui amore si è dato a me in eterno con il compiacimento e la vicinanza, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Loving (Al-Wadūd), Whose love has yielded to me forever with good pleasure and nearness, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Très-Aimant (Al-Wadūd), dont l'amour s'est donné à moi éternellement avec l'agrément et la proximité, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْمَجِيدُ الَّذِى بَانَتْ مَجَادَتُهُ ۞ وَقُدْتَّ لِى مِنْكَ مَجْدًا فَاقَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Glorioso (Al-Majīd), la cui gloria è apparsa, e mi hai condotto da Te una gloria che (tutto) supera, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Glorious (Al-Majīd), Whose glory has appeared, and You have led to me from You a glory that surpasses (all), O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Glorieux (Al-Majīd), dont la gloire est apparue, et Tu m'as conduit de Ta part une gloire qui (tout) surpasse, ô Allah.

bayts.text: وَإِنَّكَ الْبَاعِثُ الْمُبْقِى بِلَا ضَرَرٍ ۞ كَفَيْتَنِى جُمْلَةَ الْأَكْدَارِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: E in verità Tu sei Colui che risuscita (Al-Bāʿith), che fa perdurare senza danno: mi hai preservato da tutti i torbidi, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: And truly You are the Resurrector (Al-Bāʿith), Who makes endure without harm: You have spared me all turbidity, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Et en vérité Tu es Celui qui ressuscite (Al-Bāʿith), qui fait durer sans dommage : Tu m'as préservé de tous les troubles, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الشَّهِيدُ الَّذِى انْقَادَتْ شَهَادَتُهُ ۞ لِى بِاشْتِرَآئِكَ مِنِّى ذَاكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Testimone (Ash-Shahīd), la cui testimonianza si è data a me del Tuo acquisto da me di quello (che ho venduto), o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Witness (Ash-Shahīd), Whose testimony has yielded to me of Your purchase from me of that (which I sold), O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Témoin (Ash-Shahīd), dont le témoignage m'est acquis de Ton achat de moi de cela (que j'ai vendu), ô Allah.

bayts.text: يَاحَقُّ لِى اشْهَدْ بِحَقٍ وَامْحُ جُمْلَةَ مَا ۞ لَمْ تَرْضَ لِى مُطْلَقًا بِالْفَضْلِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Verità (Al-Ḥaqq), testimonia per me con verità, e cancella tutto ciò che non hai gradito per me, in assoluto, per grazia, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O Truth (Al-Ḥaqq), bear witness for me with truth, and efface all that You have not approved for me, absolutely, by grace, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Vérité (Al-Ḥaqq), témoigne pour moi avec vérité, et efface tout ce que Tu n'as pas agréé pour moi, absolument, par grâce, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْوَكِيلُ الَّذِى قَدِ اكْتَفَيْتُ بِهِ ۞ فِى الدَّفْعِ وَالْجَلْبِ يَاذَا الْخَلْقِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Garante (Al-Wakīl), del quale mi sono accontentato nel respingere (il male) e nell'attrarre (il bene), o Signore della creazione, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Trustee (Al-Wakīl), with Whom I have been content in warding off (evil) and drawing (good), O Lord of creation, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Garant (Al-Wakīl), dont je me suis contenté pour repousser (le mal) et attirer (le bien), ô Seigneur de la création, ô Allah.

verses.text: فِى السِّرِّ وَالْجَهْرِ يَاذَا الْأَمْرِ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: fis sirri wal jahri yaa zal amri yal laahu

verses.text: أَنْتَ الْمَتِينُ الَّذِى قَدْ كُنْتَ لِى بِمُنًى
verses.transcription: antal matiinul lazii qad kunta lii bimunan
walaa tuwajjihu lil makruuha yal laahu

verses.text: أَنْتَ الْوَلِىُّ الَّذِى لَآ أَبْتَغِى بَدَلًا
verses.transcription: antal waliyyul lazii laa abtaghii badalan
bihi wa lii kunta bit taamiini yal laahu

verses.text: أَنْتَ الْحَمِيدُ الَّذِى وَجَّهْتَ لِى نِعَمًا
verses.transcription: antal hamiidul lazii wajjahta lii nihaman
bilaa ghuruurin wa ghayril makri yal laahu
yaa muhsiyal khalqi wal ash-yaa-i jumlatihaa
kafaytanii durra maa ahsayta yal laahu
yaa mubdii-al khalqi yaa man laa tuwajjihu lii
maa laa uhibbu radiitu hanka yal laahu

verses.text: مُعِيدُ أَحْمَدَ عَوْدٍ قُدْتَّ لِى كَرَمًا
verses.transcription: muhiidu ahmada hawdin qudtta lii karaman

verses.text: فِى كُلِّ شَهْرٍ وَيَوْمٍ فِيكَ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: fii kulli shahrin wa yawmin fiika yal laahu

verses.text: مُحْيِى بِخَيْرِ حَيَاةٍ جُدْتَّ لِى أَبَدًا
verses.transcription: muhyii bikhayri hayaatin judtta lii abadan
falaka shukrii bisawfil humri yal laahu

verses.text: مُمِيتُ قَدْ سُقْتَ مَوْتِى لِلْعِدَى وَلَهُمْ
verses.transcription: mumiitu qad suqta mawtii lil hidaa wa lahum
makaarihii suqta fid daarayni yal laahu

verses.text: يَاحَىُّ حَمْدِى وَشُكْرِى مَعْ رِضَاىَ مَعًا
verses.transcription: yaa hayyu hamdii wa shukrii mah ridaaya mahan
minniya khuzduuna sukhtin minka yal laahu

verses.text: قَيُّومُ قَدْ قُدْتَّ لِى مَاكُنْتُ أَطْلُبُهُ
verses.transcription: qayyuumu qad qudtta lii maa kuntu atlubuhu
bighayri kasbin ilal jannaati yal laahu

verses.text: أَوْ صَلْتَ لِى وَاجِدُ الْأَثْمَانَ دُونَ عَنَآ
verses.transcription: aw salta lii waajidul asmaana duuna hanaa

verses.text: لَّكَ الْوُجُودُ الَّذِى لِى بَانَ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: lakal wujuudul lazii lii baana yal laahu
bighayri kibrin wa hujbin rabbi yal laahu
mahal munaa bihaziizi minka yal laahu

verses.text: لَكَ الْتِجَآءِى بِمَا لِى اخْتِيرَ يَاصَمَدِى
verses.transcription: lakal tijaa-ii bimaa likhtiira yaa samadii
bishran lijumlati man ahbabta yal laahu
ilaa siwaanaa lakat tahmiidu yal laahu
mahal jiwaari wa zawrin fiika yal laahu
antal muqaddimu qaddimnii hunaa wa ghadan
halaa kashiirin minal akh-yaari yal laahu
antal muwaakhkhiru azhabtal hidaa wa madaw
ilaa siwaanaa mahal  khiz-yaani yal laahu
wa innakal awwaluj halnii hunaa wa ghadan
fis saabiqiina bifadlin minka yal laahu
yaa aakhiruj halaniyad daarayni zaa rutabin
wa saqqi humrii ilal jannaati yal laahu
hannii wa azhirniyal qur-aana yal laahu
yaa baatinur zuqniyal asraara zaa minanin
wajhal fu-aadiya zarfaz zikri yal laahu
hab lii bifadlika yaa waalii muwaasalatii
khayral baraayaa wa man waalayta yal laahu
wa innakal mutahaalii suq hidaaka mahan

verses.text: إِلَى سِوَى قَصْدِ ضُرِّى الدَّهْرَ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: ilaa siwaa qasdi durrid dahra yal laahu
wassih wa mallik wa ahtiq duuna maqsadatin
wa lis tajib dahwatii ya barru yal laahu
tahharta kulliya yaa tawwaabu yal laahu

verses.text: أَنْتَ الَّذِى مِنْ عِدَى الْإِسْلَامِ مُنْتَقِمٌ
verses.transcription: antal lazii min hidal islaami muntaqimun

verses.text: وَلِى انْتَقَمْتَ بِمَا لِى اخْتَرتَ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: wa lin taqamta bimaa likhtarta yal laahu

verses.text: أَنْتَ الْعَفُوُّ الَّذِى عَنِّى عَفَوْتَ بِلَآ
verses.transcription: antal hafuwwul lazii hannii hafawta bilaa
ibqaa-i haybin hadaytal kulla yal laahu
walaa tuwajjihu lil ahdaa-a yal laahu

verses.text: يَامَالِكَ الْمُلْكِ لِى وَسَّعْتَ دُونَ جَوًى
verses.transcription: yaa maalikal mulki lii wa sahta duuna jawan
fil mulki wal malakuutid dahra yal laahu

verses.text: يَاذَا الْجَلَالِ وَذَا الْإِكْرَامِ هَبْ لِىَ مَا
verses.transcription: yaa zal jalaali wa zal ikraami hab liya maa

verses.text: لِى اخْتَرْتَ دُنْيَا وَأُخْرَى مِنْكَ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: likhtarta dunyaa wa ukhraa minka yal laahu

verses.text: قُدْ لِىَ يَامُقْسِطُ الْمَطْلوبَ حَيْثُ أُرَى
verses.transcription: qud liya yaa muqsitul matluuba haysu uraa
khillan wa hibban mahar ridwaani yal laahu
yaa jaamihuj mah liyal aghraada murtajiyan

verses.text: عَنِّى بِكَوْبِكَ لِى فِى الْجَمْعِ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: hannii bikawnika lii fil  jamhi yal laahu
antal ghaniyyul lazii laa yantamii gharadun

verses.text: إِلَيْكَ هَبْ لِىَ مَآ أَحْتَاجُ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: ilayka hab liya maa ahtaaju yal laahu
fasarmadan liya kun bil fadli yal laahu
manahta yaa maanihul aswaa-a min qibalii
walaa tuwajjihu lii maasaa-a yal laahu

verses.text: مَنَعْتَ يَاضَارُ مِنِّى الضُّرَّ فِى أَبَدٍ
verses.transcription: manahta yaa daaru minnid durra fii abadin
walaa tuwajjihu lil idraara yal laahu

verses.text: لِى قُدْتَّ فِى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ نَّفْعَ ذِى كَرَمٍ
verses.transcription: lii qudtta fii kulli shay-in nafha zii karamin
yaa naafihan lizawil iimaani yal laahu
nawwarta yaa nuuru kullii saafiyan abadan

verses.text: قَدْ قُدْتَّ لِى مِنْكَ يَاهَادِى هِدَايَةَ مَنْ
verses.transcription: qad qudtta lii minka yaa haadii hidaayata man
qad saahabul mustafal mukhtaari yal laahu
qudttal badaa-iha lil ajri yal laahu

verses.text: لِى صَفِّ عُمْرِىَ يَابَاقِى بِخَيْرِ رِضًى
verses.transcription: lii saffi humriya yaa baaqii bikhayri ridan

verses.text: لِى قُدْتَّ جُمْلَةَ مَالِى اخْتَرْتَ مِنْ مِّنَنٍ
verses.transcription: lii qudtta jumlata maa likhtarta min minanin

verses.text: أَنْتَ الرَّشِيدُ الَّذِى قَدْ قُدْتَّ لِى رَشَدًا
verses.transcription: antar rashiidul lazii qad qudtta lii rashadan

verses.text: فِى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مَّعَ التَّبْشِيرِ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: fii kulli shay-in mahat tabshiiri yal laahu

verses.text: أَنْتَ الصَّبُورُ الَّذِى وَجَّهْتَ لِى ثَمَنًا
verses.transcription: antas sabuurul lazii wajjahta lii samanan
wa qad zahabta bimaa aabaahu yal laahu

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْقَوِىُّ الَّذِى قَوَّيْتَنِى بِرِضًى ۞ فِى السِّرِّ وَالْجَهْرِ يَاذَا الْأَمْرِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Forte (Al-Qawī), che mi hai rafforzato con compiacimento, nel segreto e nel palese, o Signore del Comando, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Strong (Al-Qawī), Who have strengthened me with good pleasure, in secret and in the open, O Lord of the Command, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Fort (Al-Qawī), qui m'as fortifié avec agrément, dans le secret et le manifeste, ô Seigneur du Commandement, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْمَتِينُ الَّذِى قَدْ كُنْتَ لِى بِمُنًى ۞ وَلَا تُوَجِّهُ لِى الْمَكْرُوهَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Saldo (Al-Matīn), che sei stato per me con le aspirazioni, e non rivolgi verso di me ciò che è detestabile, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Firm (Al-Matīn), Who have been for me with aspirations, and You do not turn toward me what is hateful, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es l'Inébranlable (Al-Matīn), qui as été pour moi avec les aspirations, et Tu ne diriges pas vers moi ce qui est détestable, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْوَلِىُّ الَّذِى لَآ أَبْتَغِى بَدَلًا ۞ بِهِ وَلِى كُنْتَ بِالتَّامِينِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Protettore (Al-Walī), in cambio del quale non desidero un sostituto, e per me sei stato con la sicurezza, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Protector (Al-Walī), in exchange for Whom I seek no substitute, and You have been for me with safety, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Protecteur (Al-Walī), en échange de qui je ne désire aucun substitut, et pour moi Tu as été avec la sécurité, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْحَمِيدُ الَّذِى وَجَّهْتَ لِى نِعَمًا ۞ بِلَا غُرُورٍ وَغَيْرِ الْمَكْرِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Degno di lode (Al-Ḥamīd), che hai rivolto verso di me grazie, senza illusione e senza inganno, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Praiseworthy (Al-Ḥamīd), Who have turned graces toward me, without delusion and without guile, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Digne de louange (Al-Ḥamīd), qui as tourné vers moi des grâces, sans illusion et sans ruse, ô Allah.

bayts.text: يَامُحْصِىَ الْخَلْقِ وَالْأَشْيَآءِ جُمْلَتِهَا ۞ كَفَيْتَنِى ضُرَّ مَآ أَحْصَيْتَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Colui che enumera (Al-Muḥṣī) la creazione e le cose tutte quante, mi hai preservato dal danno di ciò che hai enumerato, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O Reckoner (Al-Muḥṣī) of creation and of all things together, You have spared me the harm of what You have numbered, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Celui qui dénombre (Al-Muḥṣī) la création et les choses toutes ensemble, Tu m'as préservé du mal de ce que Tu as dénombré, ô Allah.

bayts.text: يَامُبْدِىءَ الْخَلْقِ يَامَنْ لَّاتُوَجِّهُ لِى ۞ مَالَآ أُحِبُّ رَضِيتُ عَنْكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Iniziatore (Al-Mubdiʾ) della creazione, o Colui che non rivolgi verso di me ciò che non amo: mi sono compiaciuto di Te, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O Originator (Al-Mubdiʾ) of creation, O You Who do not turn toward me what I do not love: I am well pleased with You, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Initiateur (Al-Mubdiʾ) de la création, ô Celui qui ne diriges pas vers moi ce que je n'aime pas : je me suis satisfait de Toi, ô Allah.

bayts.text: مُعِيدُ أَحْمَدَ عَوْدٍ قُدْتَّ لِى كَرَمًا ۞ فِى كُلِّ شَهْرٍ وَيَوْمٍ فِيكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Restauratore (Al-Muʿīd), mi hai condotto per generosità il più lodevole dei ritorni, in ogni mese e in ogni giorno, in Te, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O Restorer (Al-Muʿīd), You have led to me out of generosity the most praiseworthy of returns, in every month and day, in You, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Restaurateur (Al-Muʿīd), Tu m'as conduit par générosité le plus louable des retours, en chaque mois et chaque jour, en Toi, ô Allah.

bayts.text: مُحْيِى بِخَيْرِ حَيَاةٍ جُدْتَّ لِى أَبَدًا ۞ فَلَكَ شُكْرِى بِصَفْوِ الْعُمْرِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Datore di vita (Al-Muḥyī), di una vita eccellente mi sei stato prodigo per sempre: a Te dunque la mia gratitudine, con la purezza della vita, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O Giver of life (Al-Muḥyī), with the best of lives You have been lavish to me forever: so to You is my gratitude, with purity of life, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Donateur de vie (Al-Muḥyī), d'une vie excellente Tu m'as été prodigue pour toujours : à Toi donc ma gratitude, avec la pureté de la vie, ô Allah.

bayts.text: مُمِيتُ قَدْ سُقْتَ مَوْتِى لِلْعِدَى وَلَهُمْ ۞ مَّكَارِهِى سُقْتَ فِى الدَّارَيْنِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Datore di morte (Al-Mumīt), hai sospinto la mia morte verso i nemici, e verso di loro hai sospinto le mie avversità, nelle due Dimore, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O Giver of death (Al-Mumīt), You have driven my death toward the enemies, and toward them You have driven my adversities, in the two Abodes, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Donateur de mort (Al-Mumīt), Tu as poussé ma mort vers les ennemis, et vers eux Tu as poussé mes adversités, dans les deux Demeures, ô Allah.

bayts.text: يَاحَىُّ حَمْدِى وَشُكْرِى مَعْ رِضَاىَ مَعًا ۞ مِّنِّىَ خُذْدُونَ سُخْطٍ مِّنْكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Vivente (Al-Ḥayy), la mia lode e la mia gratitudine, insieme al mio compiacimento, accoglile da me senza sdegno da parte Tua, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O Living (Al-Ḥayy), my praise and my gratitude, together with my contentment, accept them from me without displeasure on Your part, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Vivant (Al-Ḥayy), ma louange et ma gratitude, avec mon agrément, accueille-les de moi sans courroux de Ta part, ô Allah.

bayts.text: قَيُّومُ قَدْ قُدْتَّ لِى مَاكُنْتُ أَطْلُبُهُ ۞ بِغَيْرِ كَسْبٍ إِلَى الْجَنَّاتِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Sussistente (Al-Qayyūm), mi hai condotto ciò che cercavo, senza mio acquisto, fino ai Giardini, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O Self-Subsisting (Al-Qayyūm), You have led to me what I sought, without my earning, until the Gardens, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Subsistant (Al-Qayyūm), Tu m'as conduit ce que je recherchais, sans acquisition de ma part, jusqu'aux Jardins, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَوْ صَلْتَ لِى وَاجِدُ الْأَثْمَانَ دُونَ عَنَآ ۞ لَّكَ الْوُجُودُ الَّذِى لِى بَانَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai fatto giungere, o Colui che trova (Al-Wājid), i prezzi senza fatica: a Te (appartiene) l'Esistenza che mi si è manifestata, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have brought to me, O Finder (Al-Wājid), the prices without toil: Yours is the Existence that has become manifest to me, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as fait parvenir, ô Celui qui trouve (Al-Wājid), les prix sans peine : à Toi (appartient) l'Existence qui m'est apparue, ô Allah.

bayts.text: يَامَاجِدُ اجْعَلْنِىَ الدَّارَيْنِ مُعْتَلِيًا ۞ بِغَيْرِ كِبْرٍ وَعُجْبٍ رَبِّ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Nobile (Al-Mājid), rendimi elevato nelle due Dimore, senza superbia né vanità, Signore, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O Noble (Al-Mājid), make me exalted in the two Abodes, without pride or vanity, Lord, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Noble (Al-Mājid), rends-moi élevé dans les deux Demeures, sans orgueil ni vanité, Seigneur, ô Allah.

bayts.text: يَاوَاحِدُ اجْعَلْنِىَ الدَّارَيْنِ مُنْفَرِدًا ۞ مَعَ الْمُنَى بِعَزِيزِ مِّنْكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Unico (Al-Wāḥid), rendimi singolare nelle due Dimore, con le aspirazioni, per un dono prezioso da parte Tua, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O One (Al-Wāḥid), make me singular in the two Abodes, with aspirations, through a precious gift from You, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Unique (Al-Wāḥid), rends-moi singulier dans les deux Demeures, avec les aspirations, par un don précieux de Ta part, ô Allah.

bayts.text: لَكَ الْتِجَآءِى بِمَا لِى اخْتِيرَ يَاصَمَدِى ۞ بِشْرًا لِّجُمْلَةِ مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: A Te (va) il mio rifugio, in ciò che è stato scelto per me, o mio Assoluto (Aṣ-Ṣamad), come letizia per tutti coloro che hai amato, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: To You (goes) my refuge, in what has been chosen for me, O my Self-Sufficient (Aṣ-Ṣamad), as gladness for all those You have loved, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: À Toi (va) mon refuge, en ce qui a été choisi pour moi, ô mon Absolu (Aṣ-Ṣamad), comme allégresse pour tous ceux que Tu as aimés, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَرْدَيْتَ يَاقَادِرُ الْمَخْذُولَ مُنْدَفِعًا ۞ إِلَى سِوَانَا لَكَ التَّحْمِيدُ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Hai fatto precipitare, o Potente (Al-Qādir), l'abbandonato (da Dio), respinto verso altri che noi: a Te la lode, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have cast down, O Able (Al-Qādir), the forsaken one, driven off toward others than us: to You be praise, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu as fait choir, ô Puissant (Al-Qādir), le délaissé (de Dieu), repoussé vers d'autres que nous : à Toi la louange, ô Allah.

bayts.text: رَزَقْتَنِى الْحَجِّ طَيًا أَنْتَ مُخْتَدِرٌ ۞ مَّعَ الْجِوَارِ وَزَوْرٍ فِيكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai concesso il Pellegrinaggio per ripiegamento (della terra) — Tu sei l'Onnipotente — con la vicinanza (al Profeta) e la visita in Te, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have granted me the Pilgrimage by folding (of the earth) — You are the All-Powerful — with nearness (to the Prophet) and the visit in You, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as accordé le Pèlerinage par repliement (de la terre) — Tu es le Tout-Puissant — avec le voisinage (du Prophète) et la visite en Toi, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ قَدِّمْنِى هُنَا وَغَدًا ۞ عَلَى كَشِيرٍ مِّنَ الْأَخْيَارِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei Colui che fa avanzare (Al-Muqaddim): fammi avanzare quaggiù e domani su molti degli eletti, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Expediter (Al-Muqaddim): bring me forward here and tomorrow before many of the elect, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es Celui qui fait avancer (Al-Muqaddim) : fais-moi avancer ici-bas et demain devant beaucoup des élus, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْمُوَاخِّرُ أَذْهَبْتَ الْعِدَى وَمَضَوْاْ ۞ إِلَى سِوَانَا مَعَ الْخِزْيَانِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei Colui che fa indietreggiare (Al-Muʾakhkhir): hai tolto via i nemici, ed essi sono andati verso altri che noi, con l'ignominia, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Delayer (Al-Muʾakhkhir): You have removed the enemies, and they went off toward others than us, with disgrace, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es Celui qui fait reculer (Al-Muʾakhkhir) : Tu as ôté les ennemis, et ils sont partis vers d'autres que nous, avec l'ignominie, ô Allah.

bayts.text: وَإِنَّكَ الْأَوَّلُ اجْعَلْنِى هُنَا وَغَدًا ۞ فِى السَّابِقِينَ بِفَضْلٍ مِّنْكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: E in verità Tu sei il Primo (Al-Awwal): ponimi quaggiù e domani tra i precursori, per grazia da parte Tua, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: And truly You are the First (Al-Awwal): place me here and tomorrow among the forerunners, by grace from You, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Et en vérité Tu es le Premier (Al-Awwal) : place-moi ici-bas et demain parmi les devanciers, par grâce de Ta part, ô Allah.

bayts.text: يَاءَاخِرُ اجْعَلْنِىَ الدَّارَيْنِ ذَا رُتَبٍ ۞ وَصَقِّ عُمْرِى إِلَى الْجَنَّاتِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Ultimo (Al-Ākhir), rendimi dotato di ranghi nelle due Dimore, e purifica la mia vita fino ai Giardini, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O Last (Al-Ākhir), make me possessed of ranks in the two Abodes, and purify my life until the Gardens, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Dernier (Al-Ākhir), rends-moi doté de rangs dans les deux Demeures, et purifie ma vie jusqu'aux Jardins, ô Allah.

bayts.text: يَاظَاهِرُ ارْزُقْنِىَ الْمَامُولَ مُرْتَضِيًا ۞ عَنِّى وَأَظْهِرْنِىَ الْقُرْءَانَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Manifesto (Aẓ-Ẓāhir), concedimi ciò che spero, compiaciuto di me, e fammi rendere manifesto il Corano, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O Manifest (Aẓ-Ẓāhir), grant me what I hope for, well pleased with me, and make me manifest the Qurʾān, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Apparent (Aẓ-Ẓāhir), accorde-moi ce que j'espère, satisfait de moi, et fais-moi manifester le Coran, ô Allah.

bayts.text: يَابَاطِنُ ارْزُقْنِىَ الْأَسْرَارَ ذَا مِنَنٍ ۞ وَاجْعَلْ فُؤَادِىَ ظَرْفَ الذِّكْرِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Nascosto (Al-Bāṭin), concedimi i segreti, o Possessore di favori, e rendi il mio cuore vaso del ricordo, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O Hidden (Al-Bāṭin), grant me the secrets, O Possessor of favours, and make my heart the vessel of remembrance, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Caché (Al-Bāṭin), accorde-moi les secrets, ô Détenteur des faveurs, et fais de mon cœur le vase du rappel, ô Allah.

bayts.text: هَبْ لِى بِفَضْلِكَ يَاوَالِى مُوَاصَلَتِى ۞ خَيْرَ الْبَرَايَا وَمَنْ وَّالَيْتَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Concedimi, per Tua grazia, o Reggente (Al-Wālī), la mia unione con il Migliore delle creature e con coloro che hai preso come amici, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: Grant me, by Your grace, O Governor (Al-Wālī), my union with the Best of creatures and with those You have befriended, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Accorde-moi, par Ta grâce, ô Gouverneur (Al-Wālī), mon union avec le Meilleur des créatures et avec ceux que Tu as pris pour amis, ô Allah.

bayts.text: وَإِنَّكَ الْمُتَعَالِى سُقْ عِدَاكَ مَعًا ۞ إِلَى سِوَى قَصْدِ ضُرِّى الدَّهْرَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: E in verità Tu sei l'Altissimo (Al-Mutaʿālī): sospingi i Tuoi nemici, tutti insieme, verso altro che l'intento di nuocermi, per sempre, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: And truly You are the Supremely Exalted (Al-Mutaʿālī): drive Your enemies, all together, toward other than the aim of harming me, forever, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Et en vérité Tu es le Très-Élevé (Al-Mutaʿālī) : pousse Tes ennemis, tous ensemble, vers autre chose que le dessein de me nuire, pour toujours, ô Allah.

bayts.text: وَسِّعْ وَمَلِّكْ وَأَعْتِقْ دُونَ مَقْسَدَةٍ ۞ وَلِى اسْتَجِبْ دَعْوَتِى يَابَرُّ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Allarga, rendi padrone e affranca, senza corruzione, ed esaudisci per me la mia invocazione, o Benefico (Al-Barr), o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: Expand, make master and set free, without corruption, and answer for me my supplication, O Beneficent (Al-Barr), O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Élargis, rends maître et affranchis, sans corruption, et exauce pour moi mon invocation, ô Bienfaisant (Al-Barr), ô Allah.

bayts.text: عَلَىَّ تُبْتَ مَحَوْتَ الذَّنْبَ جُمْلَتَهُ ۞ طَهَّرْتَ كُلِّىَ يَاتَوَّابُ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Ti sei volto a me (perdonando), hai cancellato il peccato tutto intero, hai purificato tutto il mio essere, o Colui che accoglie il pentimento (At-Tawwāb), o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have turned to me (in forgiveness), effaced the sin entirely, purified my whole being, O Accepter of repentance (At-Tawwāb), O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es revenu vers moi (en pardonnant), Tu as effacé le péché tout entier, Tu as purifié tout mon être, ô Celui qui accueille le repentir (At-Tawwāb), ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الَّذِى مِنْ عِدَى الْإِسْلَامِ مُنْتَقِمٌ ۞ وَلِى انْتَقَمْتَ بِمَا لِى اخْتَرتَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei Colui che dei nemici dell'Islam è il Vendicatore (Al-Muntaqim), e per me Ti sei vendicato con ciò che per me hai scelto, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the One Who takes vengeance (Al-Muntaqim) on the enemies of Islam, and for me You have avenged with what You chose for me, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es Celui qui, des ennemis de l'Islam, est le Vengeur (Al-Muntaqim), et pour moi Tu T'es vengé par ce que Tu as choisi pour moi, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْعَفُوُّ الَّذِى عَنِّى عَفَوْتَ بِلَآ ۞ إِبْقَآءِ عَيْبٍ هَدَيْتَ الْكُلَّ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei Colui che cancella le colpe (Al-ʿAfuww), che mi hai perdonato senza lasciare (alcun) difetto: hai guidato tutto (il mio essere), o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Pardoner (Al-ʿAfuww), Who have pardoned me without leaving (any) fault: You have guided (my) whole (being), O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es Celui qui efface les fautes (Al-ʿAfuww), qui m'as pardonné sans laisser (aucun) défaut : Tu as guidé tout (mon être), ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الرَّءُوفُ الَّذِى عَايَنْتُ رَأْفَتَهُ ۞ وَلَاتُوَجِّهُ لِى الْأَعْدَآءَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Pietosissimo (Ar-Raʾūf), la cui pietà ho visto con i miei occhi, e non rivolgi contro di me i nemici, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Most Kind (Ar-Raʾūf), Whose kindness I have seen with my eyes, and You do not turn the enemies toward me, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Très-Compatissant (Ar-Raʾūf), dont j'ai vu de mes yeux la compassion, et Tu ne diriges pas vers moi les ennemis, ô Allah.

bayts.text: يَامَالِكَ الْمُلْكِ لِى وَسَّعْتَ دُونَ جَوًى ۞ فِى الْمُلْكِ وَالْمَلَكُوتِ الدَّهْرَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Re del Regno (Mālik al-Mulk), per me hai allargato, senza struggimento, nel Regno e nel Regno celeste, per sempre, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O King of Sovereignty (Mālik al-Mulk), for me You have widened, without anguish, in the Kingdom and the heavenly Dominion, forever, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Roi de la Royauté (Mālik al-Mulk), pour moi Tu as élargi, sans tourment, dans la Royauté et le Royaume céleste, pour toujours, ô Allah.

bayts.text: يَاذَا الْجَلَالِ وَذَا الْإِكْرَامِ هَبْ لِىَ مَا ۞ لِى اخْتَرْتَ دُنْيَا وَأُخْرَى مِنْكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Possessore della Maestà e Possessore della Generosità, donami ciò che hai scelto per me, in questo mondo e nell'altro, da parte Tua, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O Possessor of Majesty and Possessor of Generosity, grant me what You have chosen for me, in this world and the next, from You, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Détenteur de la Majesté et Détenteur de la Générosité, donne-moi ce que Tu as choisi pour moi, en ce monde et dans l'autre, de Ta part, ô Allah.

bayts.text: قُدْ لِىَ يَامُقْسِطُ الْمَطْلوبَ حَيْثُ أُرَى ۞ خِلًّا وَحِبًّا مَّعَ الرِّضْوَانِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Conducimi, o Equo (Al-Muqsiṭ), ciò che è richiesto, in modo che io sia visto (come Tuo) amico intimo e amato, con il compiacimento, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: Lead to me, O Equitable (Al-Muqsiṭ), what is sought, so that I be seen (as Your) intimate friend and beloved, with good pleasure, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Conduis-moi, ô Équitable (Al-Muqsiṭ), ce qui est recherché, de sorte que je sois vu (comme Ton) ami intime et bien-aimé, avec l'agrément, ô Allah.

bayts.text: يَاجَامِعُ اجْمَعْ لِىَ الْأَغْرَاضَ مُرْتَضِيًا ۞ عَنِّى بِكَوْبِكَ لِى فِى الْجَمْعِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Colui che riunisce (Al-Jāmiʿ), riunisci per me gli scopi, compiaciuto di me, con il Tuo essere per me nella riunione, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O Gatherer (Al-Jāmiʿ), gather my aims for me, well pleased with me, through Your being for me in the gathering, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Celui qui rassemble (Al-Jāmiʿ), rassemble pour moi les desseins, satisfait de moi, par le fait que Tu sois pour moi dans le rassemblement, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْغَنِىُّ الَّذِى لَايَنْتَمِى غَرَضٌ ۞ إِلَيْكَ هَبْ لِىَ مَآ أَحْتَاجُ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Ricco (Al-Ghanī), al quale nessuno scopo è riferibile: donami ciò di cui ho bisogno, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Rich (Al-Ghanī), to Whom no aim pertains: grant me what I need, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Riche (Al-Ghanī), à qui nul dessein ne se rapporte : donne-moi ce dont j'ai besoin, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَغْنَيْتَنِى إِنَّكَ الْمُغْنِى بِلَا سَبَبٍ ۞ فَسَرْمَدًا لِّىَ كُنْ بِالْفَضْلِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai arricchito — Tu sei l'Arricchente (Al-Mughnī) — senza causa: in eterno dunque sii per me con la grazia, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have enriched me — You are the Enricher (Al-Mughnī) — without cause: so forever be for me with grace, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as enrichi — Tu es Celui qui enrichit (Al-Mughnī) — sans cause : éternellement donc sois pour moi avec la grâce, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَعْطَيْتَنِى إِنَّكَ الْمُعْطِى مُنَى الْكُرَمَآ ۞ كَفَيْتَنِى جُمْلَةَ الْأَعْدَآءِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai dato — Tu sei il Donatore (Al-Muʿṭī) — le aspirazioni dei nobili; mi hai preservato da tutti i nemici, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have given me — You are the Giver (Al-Muʿṭī) — the aspirations of the noble; You have spared me all the enemies, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as donné — Tu es Celui qui donne (Al-Muʿṭī) — les aspirations des nobles ; Tu m'as préservé de tous les ennemis, ô Allah.

bayts.text: مَنَعْتَ يَامَانِعُ الْأَسْوَاءَ مِنْ قِبَلِى ۞ وَلَاتُوَجِّهُ لِى مَاسَآءَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Hai impedito, o Preservatore (Al-Māniʿ), i mali dal mio lato, e non rivolgi verso di me ciò che affligge, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have prevented, O Preventer (Al-Māniʿ), the evils from my side, and You do not turn toward me what grieves, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu as empêché, ô Préservateur (Al-Māniʿ), les maux de mon côté, et Tu ne diriges pas vers moi ce qui afflige, ô Allah.

bayts.text: مَنَعْتَ يَاضَارُ مِنِّى الضُّرَّ فِى أَبَدٍ ۞ وَلَاتُوَجِّهُ لِى الْإِضْرَارَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Hai impedito, o Colui che nuoce (Aḍ-Ḍārr), il danno da me per sempre, e non rivolgi verso di me il nuocere, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have prevented, O Distresser (Aḍ-Ḍārr), harm from me forever, and You do not turn harming toward me, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu as empêché, ô Celui qui nuit (Aḍ-Ḍārr), le mal de moi pour toujours, et Tu ne diriges pas vers moi la nuisance, ô Allah.

bayts.text: لِى قُدْتَّ فِى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ نَّفْعَ ذِى كَرَمٍ ۞ يَانَافِعًا لِّذَوِى الْإِيمَانِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai condotto in ogni cosa il beneficio di un Generoso, o Benefattore (An-Nāfiʿ) di coloro che hanno fede, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have led to me in everything the benefit of a Generous One, O Benefactor (An-Nāfiʿ) of those who have faith, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as conduit en toute chose le bienfait d'un Généreux, ô Bienfaiteur (An-Nāfiʿ) de ceux qui ont la foi, ô Allah.

bayts.text: نَوَّرْتَ يَانُورُ كُلِّى صَافِيًا أَبَدًا ۞ كَفَيْتَنِى ظُلَمَ الْأَشْيَآءِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Hai illuminato, o Luce (An-Nūr), tutto il mio essere, puro, per sempre; mi hai preservato dalle tenebre delle cose, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have illumined, O Light (An-Nūr), my whole being, pure, forever; You have spared me the darkness of things, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu as illuminé, ô Lumière (An-Nūr), tout mon être, pur, pour toujours ; Tu m'as préservé des ténèbres des choses, ô Allah.

bayts.text: قَدْ قُدْتَّ لِى مِنْكَ يَاهَادِى هِدَايَةَ مَنْ ۞ قَدْ صَاحَبُواْ الْمُصْطَفَى الْمُخْتَارِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai condotto da Te, o Guida (Al-Hādī), la guida di coloro che sono stati compagni dell'Eletto, il Prescelto, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have led to me from You, O Guide (Al-Hādī), the guidance of those who were companions of the Chosen, the Elect, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as conduit de Ta part, ô Guide (Al-Hādī), la guidance de ceux qui ont été les compagnons de l'Élu, le Préféré, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْبَدِيعُ الَّذِى بَانَتْ بَدَآئِعُهُ ۞ قُدْتَّ الْبَدَآئِعَ لِى بِالْأَجْرِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Creatore mirabile (Al-Badīʿ), le cui meraviglie sono apparse: mi hai condotto le meraviglie con la ricompensa, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Wondrous Originator (Al-Badīʿ), Whose wonders have appeared: You have led wonders to me with reward, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Créateur merveilleux (Al-Badīʿ), dont les merveilles sont apparues : Tu m'as conduit les merveilles avec la récompense, ô Allah.

bayts.text: لِى صَفِّ عُمْرِىَ يَابَاقِى بِخَيْرِ رِضًى ۞ وَلْتُبْقِنِى بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Purifica per me la mia vita, o Eterno (Al-Bāqī), con il migliore compiacimento, e fammi perdurare con il Libro di Allah, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: Purify my life for me, O Everlasting (Al-Bāqī), with the best good pleasure, and make me endure through the Book of Allah, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Purifie pour moi ma vie, ô Éternel (Al-Bāqī), par le meilleur agrément, et fais-moi durer par le Livre d'Allah, ô Allah.

bayts.text: لِى قُدْتَّ جُمْلَةَ مَالِى اخْتَرْتَ مِنْ مِّنَنٍ ۞ وِرَثَةً وَارِثَ الْأَمْوَاتِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai condotto l'insieme dei favori che hai scelto per me, in eredità, o Erede (Al-Wārith) dei morti, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have led to me all the favours You chose for me, as an inheritance, O Inheritor (Al-Wārith) of the dead, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as conduit l'ensemble des faveurs que Tu as choisies pour moi, en héritage, ô Héritier (Al-Wārith) des morts, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الرَّشِيدُ الَّذِى قَدْ قُدْتَّ لِى رَشَدًا ۞ فِى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مَّعَ التَّبْشِيرِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Retto Direttore (Ar-Rashīd), che mi hai condotto la rettitudine in ogni cosa, con la buona novella, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Guide to the Right Path (Ar-Rashīd), Who have led to me right guidance in everything, with glad tidings, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Guide de la rectitude (Ar-Rashīd), qui m'as conduit la rectitude en toute chose, avec la bonne nouvelle, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الصَّبُورُ الَّذِى وَجَّهْتَ لِى ثَمَنًا ۞ وَقَدْ ذَّهَبْتَ بِمَآ ءَابَاهُ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Paziente (Aṣ-Ṣabūr), che hai rivolto verso di me un prezzo (di ricompensa), e hai portato via ciò che lo rifiuta, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Patient (Aṣ-Ṣabūr), Who have turned toward me a price (of reward), and You have taken away what refuses it, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Patient (Aṣ-Ṣabūr), qui as tourné vers moi un prix (de récompense), et Tu as emporté ce qui le refuse, ô Allah.

verses.text: بُشْرَى لَنَا قَدْ أَتَانَا الْجُودُ وَالْكَرَمُ
verses.transcription: bushraa lanaa qad ataanal juudu wal karamu

verses.text: حُزْنَا مَتَابًا مَّعَ الْغُفْرَانِ فِى رَجَبٍ
verses.transcription: huznaa mataaban mahal ghufraani fii rajabin

verses.text: وَنَرْتَجِى فِى الْبَوَاقِى رَوْضَ مَنْ حُرِمُوا
verses.transcription: wa nartajii fil bawaaqii rawda man hurimuu
qahral hidaa wahwa jabbaarun wa muntaqimu
wa lastu lin nafsi fid daarayni antaqimu

verses.text: وَهْوَ الْحَكِيمُ الَّذِى مَا شَاءَ كَانَ وَمَا
verses.transcription: wahwal hakiimul lazii maa shaa-a kaana wa maa
lam yaku shaa-iyahu fad dahra yanhadimu

verses.text: لَهُ الْبَرَايَا لَهُ أَفْعَا لَهُمْ وَلَهُ
verses.transcription: lahul baraayaa lahu afhaa lahum wa lahu

verses.text: جَلَّ الْوُجُودُ الَّذِى قَدْزَا نَهُ الْقِدَمُ
verses.transcription: jallal wujuudul lazii qadzaa nahul qidamu

verses.text: فَمَنْ لَّهُ جَلَّ يَنْمِى سَرْمَدًا وَلَدًا
verses.transcription: faman lahu jalla yanmii sarmadan wa ladan

verses.text: مُثَلِّثًا فِيهِ قَدْ زَلَّتْ لَهُ الْقَدَمُ
verses.transcription: musallisan fiihi qad zallat lahul qadamu

verses.text: تُوبُوا لَهُ يَاذَوِ التَّثْلِيثِ فِى عَجَلٍ
verses.transcription: tuubuu lahu yaa zawit tasliisi fii hajalin
wa saarihuu qabla mawti bahdahu nadamu

verses.text: بِقَفْوِ مَنْ زُحْزِحَتْ عَنْ حِزْبِهِ الظُّلَمُ
verses.transcription: biqafwi man zuhzihat han hizbihiz zulamu

verses.text: اللَّهُ بَاقٍ قَدِيمٌ لَّا يَشَابِهُ مَا
verses.transcription: al laahu baaqin qadiimun laa yashaa bihu maa
bil baali yakhturu wahwal mufradul halamu
wa man yusallis fariidan maalikan samadan
fajaahilun wa yulaa fii kullahul alamu
antum huyaaraa usaaraa lil lahiini mahan

verses.text: صُمٌّ وَعُمْىٌ كَذَا فِى الْأَلْسُنِ الْبَكَمُ
verses.transcription: summun wa humyun kazaa fil alsunil bakamu

verses.text: إِنِّى لَأَحْمَدُ رَبًّا لَّا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
verses.transcription: innii laa ahmadu rabban laa shariika lahu

verses.text: فِى الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ وَهْوَ الْوَاسِعُ الْحَكَمُ
verses.transcription: fil barri wal bahri wahwal waasihul hakamu

verses.text: بِإِذْ بِهِ مِنْهُ تَاتِى قَلْبِىَ الْحِكَمُ
verses.transcription: bi-iz bihi minhu taatii qalbiyal hikamu

verses.text: وَهْوَ الَّذِى كَوْنُهُ لِى الْيَوْمَ فَرَّحَنِى
verses.transcription: wahwal lazii kawnuhu lil yawma farrahanii
wa han fu-aadiya zaalash shakku wal ghumamu

verses.text: يَالَيْتَ قَوْمِىَ فِى ذَا الْيَوْمِ قَدْ عَلِمُوا
verses.transcription: yaa layta qawmiya fii zal yawmi qad halimuu

verses.text: بِكَوْنِهِ لِىَ إِذْ عَنِّى امَّحَى اللَّمَمُ
verses.transcription: bikawnihi liya iz hannii mahal lamamu

verses.text: قَدْ كَانَ لِى وَلَهُ شُكْرِ وَمَحْمَدَتِى
verses.transcription: qad kaana lii wa lahu shukri wa mahmadatii
lahu fu-aadiya wal jusmaanu wal ghalamu

verses.text: مِنْ سَاعَتِى لاِرْتِفَاعِى وَهْوَ لِى وَلَمُ
verses.transcription: min saahatii lirtifaahii wahwa lii wa lamu

verses.text: وَهْوَ الْكِتَابُ الَّذِى مَنْ كَانَ خَادِمَهُ
verses.transcription: wahwal kitaabul lazii man kaana khaadimahu
zakaa lahul hilmu wal ahmaalu wash shiyamu
wa innanii ahbudul mawlaa bihi abadan
maafaa wa maa lizuhayrin qaadahu harimu
arjuu bikhidmatihi kawnii hunaa wa ghadan

verses.text: عِنْدَ الْمُقَدَّمِ مِثْلَ الصَّحْبِ مَنْ كَرُمُوا
verses.transcription: hindal muqaddami mislas sahbi man karumuu

verses.text: وَكَانَ لِى وَبِهِ لِى رَاضَ مَنْ حُرِمُوا
verses.transcription: wa kaana lii wa bihi lii raada man hurimuu

verses.text: وَسَاقَ لِى كُلَّ مَا أَهْوَى بِلَا طَلَبٍ
verses.transcription: wa saaqan lii kulla maa ahwaa bilaa talabin
sawqaa bihi yastabiinul judu wal karamu
maadaama rabbii wa daamal mustafaa wazari
wa bil bushaaraati tatii lashhurul hurumu

bayts.text: بُشْرَى لَنَا قَدْ أَتَانَا الْجُودُ وَالْكَرَمُ ۞ لَمَّا اسْتَهَلَّتْ عَلَيْنَا لَااشْهُرُ الْحُرُمُ

translations.it.karamati: Buona novella per noi! Ci sono giunte la generosità e la munificenza, quando sono sorti su di noi i mesi sacri.
translations.en.karamati: Glad tidings for us! Generosity and munificence have come to us, as the sacred months dawned upon us.
translations.fr.karamati: Bonne nouvelle pour nous ! La générosité et la munificence nous sont venues, quand se sont levés sur nous les mois sacrés.

bayts.text: حُزْنَا مَتَابًا مَّعَ الْغُفْرَانِ فِى رَجَبٍ ۞ وَنَرْتَجِى فِى الْبَوَاقِى رَوْضَ مَنْ حُرِمُوا

translations.it.karamati: Abbiamo conseguito il pentimento (accolto) con il perdono in Rajab, e speriamo, nei (mesi) restanti, che siano domati coloro che sono stati privati (della grazia).
translations.en.karamati: We have attained repentance (accepted) with forgiveness in Rajab, and we hope, in the remaining (months), for the taming of those who have been deprived (of grace).
translations.fr.karamati: Nous avons obtenu le repentir (agréé) avec le pardon en Rajab, et nous espérons, dans les (mois) restants, que soient domptés ceux qui ont été privés (de la grâce).

bayts.text: نَرْجُو مِنَ الْوَاحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ خَالِقِنَا ۞ قَهْرَ الْعِدَى وَهْوَ جَبَّارٌ وَمُنْتَقِمُ

translations.it.karamati: Speriamo dall'Unico, il Dominatore (Al-Wāḥid al-Qahhār), nostro Creatore, il dominio sui nemici: Egli è Irresistibile e Vendicatore.
translations.en.karamati: We hope from the One, the Subduer (Al-Wāḥid al-Qahhār), our Creator, the subduing of the enemies: He is Compeller and Avenger.
translations.fr.karamati: Nous espérons de l'Unique, le Dominateur (Al-Wāḥid al-Qahhār), notre Créateur, la domination des ennemis : Il est Contraignant et Vengeur.

bayts.text: وَهْوَ الْمُغِيثُ الَّذِى أَرْجُو إِغَاثَتَهُ ۞ وَلَسْتُ لِلنَّفْسِ فِى الدَّارَيْنِ أَنْتَقِمُ

translations.it.karamati: Egli è il Soccorritore (Al-Mughīth), il cui soccorso spero, e io non mi vendico per me stesso nelle due Dimore.
translations.en.karamati: He is the Succourer (Al-Mughīth), Whose succour I hope for, and I take no vengeance for myself in the two Abodes.
translations.fr.karamati: Il est le Secoureur (Al-Mughīth), dont j'espère le secours, et je ne me venge pas pour moi-même dans les deux Demeures.

bayts.text: وَهْوَ الْحَكِيمُ الَّذِى مَا شَاءَ كَانَ وَمَا ۞ لَمْ يَكُ شَائِيَهُ فَالدَّهْرَ يَنْعَدِمُ

translations.it.karamati: Egli è il Saggio (Al-Ḥakīm): ciò che vuole è, e ciò che non vuole resta per sempre inesistente.
translations.en.karamati: He is the Wise (Al-Ḥakīm): what He wills is, and what He does not will remains forever non-existent.
translations.fr.karamati: Il est le Sage (Al-Ḥakīm) : ce qu'Il veut est, et ce qu'Il ne veut pas demeure à jamais inexistant.

bayts.text: لَهُ الْبَرَايَا لَهُ أَفْعَا لَهُمْ وَلَهُ ۞ جَلَّ الْوُجُودُ الَّذِى قَدْزَا نَهُ الْقِدَمُ

translations.it.karamati: A Lui (appartengono) le creature, a Lui le loro azioni, e a Lui — sublime è Egli — l'Esistenza, che l'Eternità senza inizio ha adornato.
translations.en.karamati: To Him (belong) the creatures, to Him their deeds, and to Him — sublime is He — Existence, which beginningless Eternity has adorned.
translations.fr.karamati: À Lui (appartiennent) les créatures, à Lui leurs actes, et à Lui — sublime est-Il — l'Existence, que l'Éternité sans commencement a ornée.

bayts.text: فَمَنْ لَّهُ جَلَّ يَنْمِى سَرْمَدًا وَلَدًا ۞ مُثَلِّثًا فِيهِ قَدْ زَلَّتْ لَهُ الْقَدَمُ

translations.it.karamati: Chi a Lui — sublime è Egli — attribuisce in eterno un figlio, facendone una trinità, il suo piede è scivolato in ciò.
translations.en.karamati: Whoever ascribes to Him — sublime is He — forever a son, making a trinity, his foot has slipped therein.
translations.fr.karamati: Celui qui Lui — sublime est-Il — attribue éternellement un fils, en faisant une trinité, son pied a glissé en cela.

bayts.text: تُوبُوا لَهُ يَاذَوِ التَّثْلِيثِ فِى عَجَلٍ ۞ وَسَارِعُوا قَبْلَ مَوْتِ بَعْدَهُ نَدَمُ

translations.it.karamati: Pentitevi a Lui, o seguaci della Trinità, in fretta, e affrettatevi prima della morte, dopo la quale (c'è solo) rimpianto.
translations.en.karamati: Repent to Him, O people of the Trinity, in haste, and hurry before death, after which (there is only) regret.
translations.fr.karamati: Repentez-vous à Lui, ô partisans de la Trinité, en hâte, et empressez-vous avant la mort, après laquelle (il n'y a que) regret.

bayts.text: لِرَبِّكُمْ سَارِعُوْا مُسْتَسْلِمِينَ مَعًا ۞ بِقَفْوِ مَنْ زُحْزِحَتْ عَنْ حِزْبِهِ الظُّلَمُ

translations.it.karamati: Verso il vostro Signore affrettatevi, sottomessi tutti insieme, seguendo colui (il Profeta) dal cui partito sono state allontanate le tenebre.
translations.en.karamati: Hasten to your Lord, submitting all together, following him (the Prophet) from whose party the darkness has been removed.
translations.fr.karamati: Vers votre Seigneur empressez-vous, soumis tous ensemble, en suivant celui (le Prophète) du parti duquel les ténèbres ont été écartées.

bayts.text: اللَّهُ بَاقٍ قَدِيمٌ لَّا يَشَابِهُ مَا ۞ بِالْبَالِ يَخْطُرُ وَهْوَ الْمُفْرَدُ الْعَلَمُ

translations.it.karamati: Allah è Eterno, Antico, non somiglia a ciò che passa per la mente: Egli è l'Unico, il Segnalato.
translations.en.karamati: Allah is Everlasting, Ancient, He does not resemble what crosses the mind: He is the Unique, the Distinguished.
translations.fr.karamati: Allah est Éternel, Ancien, Il ne ressemble pas à ce qui passe par l'esprit : Il est l'Unique, le Signalé.

bayts.text: وَمَنْ يُّثَلِّثْ فَرِيدًا مَّالِكًا صَمَدًا ۞ فَجَاهِلٌ وَيُلَا فِى كُلَّهُ الْأَلَمُ

translations.it.karamati: E chi fa trinità di un Unico, Re, Assoluto, è un ignorante, e incontrerà tutto il dolore.
translations.en.karamati: And whoever makes a trinity of One Unique, King, Self-Sufficient, is ignorant, and shall meet all the pain.
translations.fr.karamati: Et celui qui fait une trinité d'un Unique, Roi, Absolu, est un ignorant, et il rencontrera toute la douleur.

bayts.text: أَنْتُمْ حُيَارَى أُسَارَى لِلَّعِينِ مَعًا ۞ صُمٌّ وَعُمْىٌ كَذَا فِى الْأَلْسُنِ الْبَكَمُ

translations.it.karamati: Voi siete smarriti, prigionieri del Maledetto (Satana), tutti insieme, sordi e ciechi, e così nelle lingue è il mutismo (Corano 2:18).
translations.en.karamati: You are bewildered, captives of the Accursed (Satan), all together, deaf and blind, and likewise in the tongues is dumbness (Qurʾān 2:18).
translations.fr.karamati: Vous êtes égarés, prisonniers du Maudit (Satan), tous ensemble, sourds et aveugles, et de même dans les langues est le mutisme (Coran 2:18).

bayts.text: إِنِّى لَأَحْمَدُ رَبًّا لَّا شَرِيكَ لَهُ ۞ فِى الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ وَهْوَ الْوَاسِعُ الْحَكَمُ

translations.it.karamati: In verità io lodo un Signore che non ha associato, sulla terraferma e sul mare: Egli è il Vasto, il Giudice.
translations.en.karamati: Truly I praise a Lord Who has no partner, on land and on sea: He is the All-Embracing, the Judge.
translations.fr.karamati: En vérité je loue un Seigneur qui n'a point d'associé, sur la terre ferme et sur la mer : Il est le Vaste, le Juge.

bayts.text: أَدْعُوهُ وَهْوَ كَرِيمٌ لَّا يُخَيِّبُنِى ۞ بِإِذْ بِهِ مِنْهُ تَاتِى قَلْبِىَ الْحِكَمُ

translations.it.karamati: Lo invoco, ed Egli è Generoso, non mi delude, poiché per mezzo di Lui, da Lui, giungono al mio cuore le sapienze.
translations.en.karamati: I call upon Him, and He is Generous, He does not disappoint me, since through Him, from Him, wisdoms come to my heart.
translations.fr.karamati: Je L'invoque, et Il est Généreux, Il ne me déçoit pas, puisque par Lui, de Lui, viennent à mon cœur les sagesses.

bayts.text: وَهْوَ الَّذِى كَوْنُهُ لِى الْيَوْمَ فَرَّحَنِى ۞ وَعَنْ فُؤَادِىَ زَالَ الشَّكُّ وَالْغُمَمُ

translations.it.karamati: Egli è Colui il cui essere per me, oggi, mi ha rallegrato, e dal mio cuore si sono dileguati il dubbio e le angosce.
translations.en.karamati: He is the One Whose being for me today has gladdened me, and from my heart doubt and anguish have vanished.
translations.fr.karamati: Il est Celui dont l'être pour moi, aujourd'hui, m'a réjoui, et de mon cœur se sont dissipés le doute et les angoisses.

bayts.text: يَالَيْتَ قَوْمِىَ فِى ذَا الْيَوْمِ قَدْ عَلِمُوا ۞ بِكَوْنِهِ لِىَ إِذْ عَنِّى امَّحَى اللَّمَمُ

translations.it.karamati: Volesse il cielo che il mio popolo, in questo giorno, sapesse del Suo essere per me (Corano 36:26), quando da me si sono cancellate le colpe lievi.
translations.en.karamati: Would that my people, on this day, knew of His being for me (Qurʾān 36:26), when the minor faults were effaced from me.
translations.fr.karamati: Plût au ciel que mon peuple, en ce jour, sût qu'Il est pour moi (Coran 36:26), quand de moi se sont effacées les fautes légères.

bayts.text: قَدْ كَانَ لِى وَلَهُ شُكْرِ وَمَحْمَدَتِى ۞ لَهُ فُؤَادِىَ وَالْجُثْمَانُ وَالْغَلَمُ

translations.it.karamati: Egli è stato per me, e a Lui la mia gratitudine e la mia lode; a Lui il mio cuore, il corpo e il calamo.
translations.en.karamati: He has been for me, and to Him are my gratitude and my praise; to Him my heart, the body and the pen.
translations.fr.karamati: Il a été pour moi, et à Lui ma gratitude et ma louange ; à Lui mon cœur, le corps et le calame.

bayts.text: لَهُ شُكُورِ بِقُرْءَانٍ أُرَتِّلُهُ ۞ مِنْ سَاعَتِى لاِرْتِفَاعِى وَهْوَ لِى وَلَمُ

translations.it.karamati: A Lui la mia gratitudine, con un Corano che salmodio, dalla mia ora (presente) fino alla mia elevazione, ed Egli è per me un convito.
translations.en.karamati: To Him is my gratitude, with a Qurʾān I chant, from my (present) hour until my raising up, and He is a banquet for me.
translations.fr.karamati: À Lui ma gratitude, par un Coran que je psalmodie, de mon heure (présente) jusqu'à mon élévation, et Il est pour moi un festin.

bayts.text: وَهْوَ الْكِتَابُ الَّذِى مَنْ كَانَ خَادِمَهُ ۞ زَكَى لَهُ الْعِاْمُ وَالْأَعْمَالُ وَالشِّيَمُ

translations.it.karamati: Esso è il Libro: chi ne è stato servitore, gli si sono purificati la scienza, le opere e le indoli.
translations.en.karamati: It is the Book: whoever has been its servant, knowledge, deeds and character have been purified for him.
translations.fr.karamati: Il est le Livre : quiconque en a été le serviteur, pour lui se sont purifiés la science, les œuvres et les natures.

bayts.text: وَإِنَّنِى أَعْبُدُ الْمَوْلَى بِهِ أَبَدًا ۞ ذَاخِدْمَةٍ لِّشَفِيعٍ جُدُوهُ دِيَمُ

translations.it.karamati: E in verità io adoro il Signore per mezzo di esso per sempre, servitore di un Intercessore i cui doni sono piogge continue.
translations.en.karamati: And truly I worship the Lord through it forever, servant of an Intercessor whose gifts are continuous rains.
translations.fr.karamati: Et en vérité j'adore le Seigneur par lui pour toujours, serviteur d'un Intercesseur dont les dons sont des pluies continues.

bayts.text: وَهْوَ الْكَرِيمُ الَّذِى أَرْجُو بِخِدْمَتِهِ ۞ مَافَا وَمَا لِزُهَيْرٍ قَادَهُ هَرِمُ

translations.it.karamati: Egli è il generoso (il Profeta), per il cui servizio spero ciò che supera quanto Harim condusse a Zuhayr.
translations.en.karamati: He is the generous one (the Prophet), through whose service I hope for what surpasses what Harim led to Zuhayr.
translations.fr.karamati: Il est le généreux (le Prophète), par le service duquel j'espère ce qui dépasse ce que Harim conduisit à Zuhayr.

bayts.text: أَرْجُو بِخِدْمَتِهِ كَوْنِى هُنَا وَغَدًا ۞ عِنْدَ الْمُقَدَّمِ مِثْلَ الصَّحْبِ مَنْ كَرُمُوا

translations.it.karamati: Spero, per il suo servizio, di essere quaggiù e domani presso il Preposto (Muḥammad), come i Compagni, coloro che furono nobili.
translations.en.karamati: I hope, through his service, to be here and tomorrow with the Foremost (Muḥammad), like the Companions, those who were noble.
translations.fr.karamati: J'espère, par son service, être ici-bas et demain auprès du Placé en tête (Muḥammad), comme les Compagnons, ceux qui furent nobles.

bayts.text: صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ بِتَسْلِيمٍ بِمَنْ مَّعَهُ ۞ وَكَانَ لِى وَبِهِ لِى رَاضَ مَنْ حُرِمُوا

translations.it.karamati: Lo benedica (Allah) con il saluto, insieme a coloro che sono con lui; ed Egli è stato per me, e per mezzo di lui ha domato per me coloro che furono privati (della grazia).
translations.en.karamati: May (Allah) bless him with peace, together with those who are with him; and He has been for me, and through him He has tamed for me those who were deprived (of grace).
translations.fr.karamati: Qu'(Allah) le bénisse par le salut, avec ceux qui sont avec lui ; et Il a été pour moi, et par lui Il a dompté pour moi ceux qui furent privés (de la grâce).

bayts.text: وَسَاقَ لِى كُلَّ مَا أَهْوَى بِلَا طَلَبٍ ۞ سَوْقًا بِهِ يَسْتَبِينُ الْجُدُ وَالْكَرَمُ

translations.it.karamati: E mi ha sospinto tutto ciò che desidero, senza richiesta, di un sospingere per mezzo del quale si manifestano la generosità e la munificenza.
translations.en.karamati: And He has driven to me all that I desire, without asking, with a driving through which generosity and munificence become manifest.
translations.fr.karamati: Et Il m'a acheminé tout ce que je désire, sans demande, d'un acheminement par lequel se manifestent la générosité et la munificence.

bayts.text: مَادَامَ رَبِّى وَدَامَ الْمُصْطَفَى وَزَرِ ۞ وَبِالْبُشَارَاتِ تَاتِى الَاشْهُرُ الْحُرُمُ

translations.it.karamati: Finché durerà il mio Signore, e durerà l'Eletto (come) mio rifugio, con le buone novelle giungeranno i mesi sacri.
translations.en.karamati: As long as my Lord endures, and the Chosen One endures (as) my refuge, with glad tidings the sacred months shall come.
translations.fr.karamati: Tant que durera mon Seigneur, et que durera l'Élu (comme) mon refuge, avec les bonnes nouvelles viendront les mois sacrés.

verses.transcription: lil ghurri fal kulli ajaaba bisawaab

verses.text: مَضَوْاْ وَمَنْ يَّاتِى وَفَاقَتْ ذَا الزّّمَنْ
verses.transcription: madaw wa man yaatii wa faaqat zaz zaman
hawaa wa jaada bil qiraa wan nuzuli
farra lahu fadlan wa qad hawaahu

bayts.text: فَاقَ جَمِيعَ الْأَنْبِيَآ وَالرُّسُولِ ۞ سَيِّدِنُآ أَحْمَدُ حِبُّ الْمُرْسِلِ

translations.it.karamati: Ha superato tutti i profeti e gli inviati il nostro signore Aḥmad, l'amato di Colui che invia.
translations.en.karamati: Our master Aḥmad, the beloved of the Sender, has surpassed all the prophets and messengers.
translations.fr.karamati: A surpassé tous les prophètes et les envoyés notre maître Aḥmad, le bien-aimé de Celui qui envoie.

bayts.text: قَدَّمَ أَحْمَدَ عَلَى الْكِرَامِ ۞ مُسْرٍ بِهِ لِلْكُلِّ بِاحْتَرَامِ

translations.it.karamati: Ha anteposto Aḥmad ai nobili Colui che lo ha fatto viaggiare di notte (Corano 17:1), con rispetto da parte di tutti.
translations.en.karamati: He Who made him journey by night (Qurʾān 17:1) has set Aḥmad before the noble ones, with the reverence of all.
translations.fr.karamati: A placé Aḥmad devant les nobles Celui qui l'a fait voyager de nuit (Coran 17:1), avec le respect de tous.

bayts.text: دَرَجَةُ الْعَبْدِ الرَّسُولِ أَحْمَدَا ۞ صَيَّرَتِ الْأَخْيَارَ غُرًّا حُمَّدَا

translations.it.karamati: Il grado del servo, l'Inviato Aḥmad, ha reso gli eletti radiosi e lodevoli.
translations.en.karamati: The degree of the servant, the Messenger Aḥmad, has made the elect radiant and praiseworthy.
translations.fr.karamati: Le degré du serviteur, l'Envoyé Aḥmad, a rendu les élus radieux et louables.

bayts.text: جَادَ النَّبِى يَوْمَ أَلَسْتُ بِجَوَابْ ۞ لِلْغُرِّ فَالْكُلِّ أَجَابَ بِصَوَابْ

translations.it.karamati: Il Profeta, nel giorno di «Non sono Io (il vostro Signore)?» (Corano 7:172), ha elargito la risposta ai radiosi, e tutti hanno risposto rettamente.
translations.en.karamati: The Prophet, on the day of “Am I not (your Lord)?” (Qurʾān 7:172), bestowed the answer upon the radiant ones, and all answered rightly.
translations.fr.karamati: Le Prophète, au jour de « Ne suis-Je pas (votre Seigneur) ? » (Coran 7:172), a gratifié les radieux de la réponse, et tous ont répondu avec justesse.

bayts.text: أَعْجَزَ كُلِّ وَالِدٍ وَوَالِدَهْ ۞ أَحْمَدُنَا الَّذِى عُلَاهُ خَالِدَهْ

translations.it.karamati: Ha reso impotente (a generarne uno simile) ogni padre e ogni madre il nostro Aḥmad, la cui altezza è eterna.
translations.en.karamati: Our Aḥmad, whose loftiness is everlasting, has left every father and mother powerless (to beget his like).
translations.fr.karamati: A rendu impuissant (à en engendrer un pareil) tout père et toute mère notre Aḥmad, dont la hauteur est éternelle.

bayts.text: ءَايَاتُ أَحْمَدَ حَوَتْ ءَايَاتِ مَنْ ۞ مَضَوْاْ وَمَنْ يَّاتِى وَفَاقَتْ ذَا الزّّمَنْ

translations.it.karamati: I segni di Aḥmad hanno racchiuso i segni di coloro che sono passati e di chi verrà, e hanno superato questo tempo.
translations.en.karamati: The signs of Aḥmad have encompassed the signs of those who have passed and of whoever will come, and have surpassed this age.
translations.fr.karamati: Les signes d'Aḥmad ont renfermé les signes de ceux qui sont passés et de qui viendra, et ont surpassé ce temps.

bayts.text: كِتَابُهُ كُتُبَ رُسْلِ الْمُنْزِلِ ۞ حَوَى وَجَادَ باِلْقِرَى وَالنُّزُلِ

translations.it.karamati: Il suo Libro ha racchiuso i Libri degli inviati di Colui che fa scendere (la Rivelazione), e ha elargito l'ospitalità e il banchetto.
translations.en.karamati: His Book has encompassed the Books of the messengers of the One Who sends down (the Revelation), and has bestowed hospitality and the banquet.
translations.fr.karamati: Son Livre a renfermé les Livres des envoyés de Celui qui fait descendre (la Révélation), et a gratifié de l'hospitalité et du festin.

bayts.text: مُحَمَّدٌ عَلَيْهِ أَفْضَلُ سَلَامْ ۞ مُقَدَّمٌ بِخَيْرِ فِعْلٍ وَكَلَامْ

translations.it.karamati: Muḥammad — su di lui il più eccellente saluto — è preposto per la migliore azione e parola.
translations.en.karamati: Muḥammad — upon him the most excellent peace — is set foremost by the best of deed and word.
translations.fr.karamati: Muḥammad — sur lui le plus excellent salut — est placé en tête par la meilleure action et parole.

bayts.text: بِدَايَةُ الْمَاحِى نِهَايَةُ الْخِيَارْ ۞ فَضَّلَهُ عَلَى الْوَرَى ذُوالْإِخْتِيَارْ

translations.it.karamati: L'inizio di al-Māḥī (Muḥammad) è il termine (cui giungono) gli eletti: lo ha preferito alle creature il Signore della scelta.
translations.en.karamati: The beginning of al-Māḥī (Muḥammad) is the end (reached by) the elect: the Lord of choice has preferred him above the creatures.
translations.fr.karamati: Le commencement d'al-Māḥī (Muḥammad) est le terme (où parviennent) les élus : l'a préféré aux créatures le Seigneur du choix.

bayts.text: شَهِدَ كُلُّ سَيِّدٍ يُخْتَارُ ۞ بِأَنَّ أَحْمَدَ هُوَالْمُخْتَارُ

translations.it.karamati: Ha testimoniato ogni signore che viene scelto che Aḥmad è il Prescelto.
translations.en.karamati: Every master who is chosen has testified that Aḥmad is the Chosen One.
translations.fr.karamati: Tout seigneur qui est choisi a témoigné qu'Aḥmad est l'Élu.

bayts.text: يَنْقَادُ لِلْمُخْتَارِ مَاسِوَاهُ ۞ فَرَّ لَهُ فَضْلًا وَقَدْ حَوَاهُ

translations.it.karamati: Si sottomette al Prescelto ciò che è altro da lui; (ogni bene) si è rifugiato verso di lui per grazia, ed egli lo ha racchiuso.
translations.en.karamati: All that is other than him yields to the Chosen One; (every good) has fled to him by grace, and he has encompassed it.
translations.fr.karamati: Se soumet à l'Élu ce qui est autre que lui ; (tout bien) s'est réfugié vers lui par grâce, et il l'a renfermé.

bayts.text: رَسُولُنَا فَاقَ جَمِيعَ الرُّسُولِ ۞ وَالْأَنْبِيَآ وَهْوَ حَبِيبُ الْمُرْسِلِ

translations.it.karamati: Il nostro Inviato ha superato tutti gli inviati e i profeti, ed egli è l'amato di Colui che invia.
translations.en.karamati: Our Messenger has surpassed all the messengers and the prophets, and he is the beloved of the Sender.
translations.fr.karamati: Notre Envoyé a surpassé tous les envoyés et les prophètes, et il est le bien-aimé de Celui qui envoie.

verses.transcription: yaa mukhrijan habda kazaa min ghummatih
uktub salaatan wa salaaman lin nabii
fil aali was sahbi zawit tajannubi
bil laahi war rahmani war rahiimi hab

verses.text: لِمَنْ يُّحِبُّو نَكَ مَا يَمْحُو الرَّهَبْ
verses.transcription: liman yuhibbuu naka maa yamhur rahab
yaa khayra man yajuudu bit taqdiimi
bikaramin wa minnatin wa bish shukuur
bil laahi war rahmaani war rahiimi yaa
hab lil laziina aamanuu wa aslamuu
fii hizbihi yaa man habaaniya bisuul

bayts.text: فَرِّجْ بِجَاهِ الْمُصْطَفَى عَنْ أُمَّتِهْ ۞ يَامُخْرِجًا عَبْدَ كَذَا مِنْ غُمَّتِهْ

translations.it.karamati: Dona sollievo, per il rango dell'Eletto, alla sua comunità, o Tu che hai tratto il Tuo servo tale dalla sua angoscia.
translations.en.karamati: Grant relief, by the rank of the Chosen One, to his community, O You Who drew such-and-such a servant out of his distress.
translations.fr.karamati: Accorde la délivrance, par le rang de l'Élu, à sa communauté, ô Toi qui as tiré Ton serviteur un tel de son angoisse.

bayts.text: أُكْتُبْ صَلَاةً وَسَلَامً لِّلنَّبِى ۞ فِى الْئَالِ وَالصَّحْبِ ذَوِى التَّجَنُّبِ

translations.it.karamati: Scrivi benedizione e saluto per il Profeta, insieme alla Famiglia e ai Compagni, coloro che si tengono lontani (dal male).
translations.en.karamati: Write blessing and peace for the Prophet, with the Family and the Companions, those who keep away (from evil).
translations.fr.karamati: Écris bénédiction et salut pour le Prophète, avec la Famille et les Compagnons, ceux qui se tiennent à l'écart (du mal).

bayts.text: سَلِّمْ بِجَاهِهِ وَجَاهِهِمْ مَّعَا ۞ أُمَّتَهُ يَاوَاحِدًا لِى قَمَعَا

translations.it.karamati: Preserva, per il suo rango e il loro rango insieme, la sua comunità, o Unico che hai domato (i nemici) per me.
translations.en.karamati: Keep safe, by his rank and their rank together, his community, O One Who subdued (the enemies) for me.
translations.fr.karamati: Préserve, par son rang et leur rang ensemble, sa communauté, ô Unique qui as dompté (les ennemis) pour moi.

bayts.text: تَفَضَّلَنْ عَلَى ذَوِى الْإِيمَانِ ۞ بِفَرِجٍ يَاوَاهِبَ الْأَمَانِ

translations.it.karamati: Concedi per grazia ai credenti un sollievo, o Donatore della sicurezza.
translations.en.karamati: Bestow by grace upon the believers a relief, O Giver of safety.
translations.fr.karamati: Accorde par grâce aux croyants une délivrance, ô Donateur de la sécurité.

bayts.text: جَمِيلُ أَوْصِلْ لِّجَمِيعِ الْمُسْلِيمِنْ ۞ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ أَمْنَ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينْ

translations.it.karamati: O Bello (Al-Jamīl), fa' giungere a tutti i musulmani e le musulmane la sicurezza del Signore dei mondi.
translations.en.karamati: O Beautiful (Al-Jamīl), make the safety of the Lord of the worlds reach all Muslim men and women.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Beau (Al-Jamīl), fais parvenir à tous les musulmans et les musulmanes la sécurité du Seigneur des mondes.

bayts.text: أُكْتُبْ صَفَاءً لِّجَمِيعِ الْمُحْسِنِينْ ۞ وَالْمُحْسِنَاتِ يَاوَلِىَّ الْمُومِنِينْ

translations.it.karamati: Scrivi purezza per tutti coloro e tutte coloro che operano il bene, o Protettore dei credenti.
translations.en.karamati: Write purity for all men and women who do good, O Protector of the believers.
translations.fr.karamati: Écris la pureté pour tous ceux et toutes celles qui font le bien, ô Protecteur des croyants.

bayts.text: بِاللَّهِ وَالرَّحْمَانِ وَالرَّحِيمِ هَبْ ۞ لِمَنْ يُّحِبُّو نَكَ مَا يَمْحُو الرَّهَبْ

translations.it.karamati: Per (il Nome di) Allah, del Compassionevole e del Misericordioso, dona a coloro che Ti amano ciò che cancella il timore.
translations.en.karamati: By (the Name of) Allah, the All-Merciful and the Most Merciful, grant those who love You what effaces fear.
translations.fr.karamati: Par (le Nom d')Allah, du Tout-Miséricordieux et du Très-Miséricordieux, donne à ceux qui T'aiment ce qui efface la crainte.

bayts.text: لِوَجْهِكَ الْكَرِيمِ وَجِّهْ فَرَجَا ۞ بِلَآ أَذًى لِّمَنْ يُّدِيمُونَ الرَّجَآ

translations.it.karamati: Per il Tuo nobile Volto, rivolgi un sollievo senza danno a coloro che perseverano nella speranza.
translations.en.karamati: By Your noble Face, turn a relief without harm toward those who persevere in hope.
translations.fr.karamati: Par Ta noble Face, dirige une délivrance sans dommage vers ceux qui persévèrent dans l'espérance.

bayts.text: هَبْ لِذَوِى الْإِيمَانِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ ۞ خَيْرَ بُشَارَاتٍ بِلَا مَلَامِ

translations.it.karamati: Dona a coloro che hanno la fede e l'Islam le migliori buone novelle, senza biasimo.
translations.en.karamati: Grant those who have faith and Islam the best of glad tidings, without blame.
translations.fr.karamati: Donne à ceux qui ont la foi et l'Islam les meilleures bonnes nouvelles, sans blâme.

bayts.text: مَحَوْتَضُرَّ عَبْدِكَ الْخَدِيمِ ۞ يَاخَيْرَ مَنْ يَّجُودُ بِالتَّقْدِيمِ

translations.it.karamati: Hai cancellato il danno del Tuo servo, il Khadīm, o migliore di chi elargisce anteponendo (all'onore).
translations.en.karamati: You have effaced the harm of Your servant, the Khadīm, O best of those who bestow by setting foremost.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu as effacé le mal de Ton serviteur, le Khadīm, ô meilleur de ceux qui gratifient en plaçant en tête.

bayts.text: رَفَعْتَ سَعْيَهُ إِلَيْكَ يَاشَكُورْ ۞ بِكَرَمٍ وَمِنَّةٍ وَبِالشُّكُورْ

translations.it.karamati: Hai innalzato il suo sforzo verso di Te, o Riconoscente (Ash-Shakūr), con generosità, favore e gratitudine.
translations.en.karamati: You have raised his striving to You, O Appreciative (Ash-Shakūr), with generosity, favour and gratitude.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu as élevé son effort vers Toi, ô Reconnaissant (Ash-Shakūr), avec générosité, faveur et gratitude.

bayts.text: بِحَقِّ وَجْهِكَ الْكَرِيمِ هَبْ لَهُ ۞ إِجَابَةً يَامَنْ مَّحَوْتَ كَبْلَهُ

translations.it.karamati: Per il diritto del Tuo nobile Volto, donagli esaudimento, o Tu che hai cancellato le sue catene.
translations.en.karamati: By the right of Your noble Face, grant him an answer, O You Who have effaced his chains.
translations.fr.karamati: Par le droit de Ta noble Face, accorde-lui l'exaucement, ô Toi qui as effacé ses chaînes.

bayts.text: بِاللَّهِ وَالرَّحْمَانِ وَالرَّحِيمِ يَا ۞ مَنْ بِقَرِيبٍ وَمُجِيبٍ سُمِّيَا

translations.it.karamati: Per Allah, il Compassionevole e il Misericordioso, o Colui che è stato nominato il Vicino (Al-Qarīb) e Colui che esaudisce (Al-Mujīb).
translations.en.karamati: By Allah, the All-Merciful and the Most Merciful, O He Who has been named the Near (Al-Qarīb) and the Responsive (Al-Mujīb).
translations.fr.karamati: Par Allah, le Tout-Miséricordieux et le Très-Miséricordieux, ô Celui qui a été nommé le Proche (Al-Qarīb) et Celui qui exauce (Al-Mujīb).

bayts.text: هَبْ لِلَّذِينَءَامَنُواْ وَأَسْلَمُواْ ۞ فِرَاقَ فِتْنَةِ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ

translations.it.karamati: Dona a coloro che hanno creduto e si sono sottomessi la separazione dalla prova (seduttrice) di coloro che hanno commesso ingiustizia.
translations.en.karamati: Grant those who have believed and submitted separation from the (seductive) trial of those who have done wrong.
translations.fr.karamati: Donne à ceux qui ont cru et se sont soumis la séparation d'avec l'épreuve (séductrice) de ceux qui ont commis l'injustice.

bayts.text: مُصَلِّيًا مُّسَلِّمًا عَلَى الرَّسُولْ ۞ فِى حِزْبِهِ يَامَنْ حَبَانِىَ بِسُولْ

translations.it.karamati: benedicendo e salutando l'Inviato insieme al suo partito, o Colui che mi ha gratificato di ciò che chiedevo.
translations.en.karamati: blessing and greeting the Messenger with his party, O He Who has favoured me with what I asked.
translations.fr.karamati: en bénissant et en saluant l'Envoyé avec son parti, ô Celui qui m'a gratifié de ce que je demandais.

translations.fr: Bonheur à ceux qui se conforment au jeûne (du mois de Ramadan),

verses.transcription: shahrin bihi ughliqa baabun lil iyaam

translations.fr: car durant ce mois on ferme les portes du châtiment.
